bind_address.description: IP address the proxy listens on for incoming FTP control connections.

port.description: Port number for the FTP control connection listener.

passive_ports.description: Port range for passive FTP data connections (min and max).

start.description: First port in the passive data range.

end.description: Last port in the passive data range.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous FTP sessions allowed.

syslog.description: Whether to log to the system logger (syslog) instead of a file.

logfile.description: Path to log file when syslog is disabled. Ignored if syslog=true.

control_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in seconds) for FTP control connections before disconnect.

transfer_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for FTP data transfers (no data = disconnect).

chroot_anonymous.description: Enable chroot jail for anonymous (guest) users for security.

chroot_local.description: Enable chroot jail for local (authenticated) users for security.

allowed_networks.description: List of client IP subnets (in CIDR notation) allowed to connect. Order matters if combined with deny_networks.

denied_networks.description: List of client IP subnets (in CIDR notation) explicitly blocked. Evaluated after allowed networks.

virtual_hosts.description: List of virtual host mappings. Each entry maps a client-requested hostname to a backend target.

name.description: Hostname the proxy expects in the FTP HOST command or DNS reverse lookup.

target.description: Backend FTP server address (host:port or IP:port) to proxy to for this host.

enabled.description: Whether to enable SSL/TLS encryption on connections.

cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file.

key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file.

min_version.description: Minimum supported TLS version (e.g., TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3).

enabled.description: Whether to enable a dedicated FTPS port (implicit FTPS).

port.description: Port for implicit FTPS (SSL handshake begins immediately).

explicit.description: Enable AUTH TLS on the standard FTP port (explicit FTPS).
